'''Trooper-1234 Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Trooper-1234]]
* '''Published:''' 17 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Holotheatre
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Executor Holotheatre Trooper-1234.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Here is my favorite deck.

The published list has 59 cards.
